craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of practiced freedom — fire-and-freedom song, practice to vision. Soon-no-doubt double kept; pure-state hinge. Rejected: (a) soon→quickly → killed: soon is nearer. Read aloud: BY-this-POW-er JOINED … HERE-no-DOUBT.

lines: By this power joined, marked with freedom — the yogi attains
the pure state. That, soon — here no doubt.
l4.sanskrit_cite: etadbalena saṃyukto yogī nirvāṇalakṣaṇaḥ | padaṃ prāpnoti vimalaṃ so

reads_against.argmap: What does the joined yogi attain? → Joined attains pure soon, doubtless.
c1_essence: Awake fire swallows; all-devouring to be known.
Grown fire shines knowing-made; nectar outside.
Constant knower freed frees scores flash-fast.
reads_against.c1_rasa: vīra of practiced freedom; raudra of devouring fire; vīra of soon attainment; adbhuta of shining universe; līlā-śānta of still play; karuṇa-vīra of freeing; śānta of standing; vīra of desired-in-distraction; adbhuta of shown vision; adbhuta of bodiless expansion
